description: Erfolgreiche, korrigierte, zurueckgenommene und technisch problematische Matchergebnisvorgaenge fuer Live und PAJ.

panels.description: Erstmalig erfolgreich eingetragene Matchergebnisse im ausgewaehlten Zeitraum.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({deployment="$deployment",service="epiber-backend"} | json | event="audit_recorded" | action=~"setMatchResult|adminCorrectRankingResult|adminSetMatchEnd|adminClearMatchResult" | competitionId=~"$competitionId" | result="success" | changeType="result" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Erfolgreiche Ergebniseintraege

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({deployment="$deployment",service="epiber-backend"} | json | event="audit_recorded" | action=~"setMatchResult|adminCorrectRankingResult|adminSetMatchEnd|adminClearMatchResult" | competitionId=~"$competitionId" | result="success" | changeType="result_corrected" [$__range])) or vector(0)

sum(count_over_time({deployment="$deployment",service="epiber-backend"} | json | event="audit_recorded" | action=~"setMatchResult|adminCorrectRankingResult|adminSetMatchEnd|adminClearMatchResult" | competitionId=~"$competitionId" | result="success" | changeType="result_cleared" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.description: Erfolgreiche Korrekturen des Matchendes ohne Aenderung des Ergebnisses.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({deployment="$deployment",service="epiber-backend"} | json | event="audit_recorded" | action=~"setMatchResult|adminCorrectRankingResult|adminSetMatchEnd|adminClearMatchResult" | competitionId=~"$competitionId" | result="success" | changeType="match_end_corrected" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: MatchEnd-Korrekturen

panels.description: Fehlgeschlagene und unklare Fachausgaenge nach kontrollierter Aktion, Ausgang und Fehlercode.

targets.expr: sum by (action, result, errorCode) (count_over_time({deployment="$deployment",service="epiber-backend"} | json | event="audit_recorded" | action=~"setMatchResult|adminCorrectRankingResult|adminSetMatchEnd|adminClearMatchResult" | competitionId=~"$competitionId" | result=~"failed|unknown" [$__auto]))

panels.title: Fehlgeschlagene und unklare Ausgaenge

panels.description: Auditverlauf mit ausschliesslich kontrollierten Abschlussfeldern. IDs werden nur aus dem JSON-Inhalt gelesen und sind keine Loki-Labels.

targets.expr: {deployment="$deployment",service="epiber-backend"} | json | event="audit_recorded" | action=~"setMatchResult|adminCorrectRankingResult|adminSetMatchEnd|adminClearMatchResult" | competitionId=~"$competitionId" | keep matchId, competitionId, changeType, completionType, source, shiftedCount, koTargetMatchId, koTargetStatus, actorName, actorId, result, errorCode, requestId | line_format "Match {{.matchId}} | Bewerb {{.competitionId}} | {{.changeType}} / {{.completionType}} | {{.source}} | Verschiebungen {{.shiftedCount}}{{if .koTargetMatchId}} | KO-Ziel {{.koTargetMatchId}}{{end}}{{if .koTargetStatus}} | KO-Status {{.koTargetStatus}}{{end}} | {{.actorName}} ({{.actorId}}) | {{.result}}{{if .errorCode}} | {{.errorCode}}{{end}} | Support {{.requestId}}"

panels.title: Matchergebnis-Audit

panels.description: Abgelehnte oder fehlgeschlagene technische WebSocket-Abschluesse der vier Ergebnisoperationen.

targets.expr: {deployment="$deployment",service="epiber-backend"} | json | event="ws_request_completed" | endpoint=~"setMatchResult|adminCorrectRankingResult|adminSetMatchEnd|adminClearMatchResult" | result=~"rejected|failed" | keep endpoint, result, errorCode, durationMs, supportId | line_format "{{.endpoint}} | {{.result}} | {{.errorCode}} | {{.durationMs}} ms | Support {{.supportId}}"

panels.title: Technische WS-Fehler

list.description: Optionaler Regexfilter auf das geparste JSON-Feld competitionId; IDs bleiben ausdruecklich ohne Loki-Label.
list.label: Bewerb-ID (Regex)
list.name: competitionId
